title: build two-target canary enrollment and exact approval package

criteria: Target set contains at least two non-duplicate enrolled canary targets or records a target-set denial.

Exact approval binds actor, release id, object digest, target ids, target set digest, AgentCore PlanSpec hash, SecurityExecution policy, rollback baseline, support/recovery digest, audit sink, expiry, nonce, and policy version.
Broad, stale, missing, single-target, duplicate-target, or mismatched approval fails closed.
